 "proposal_content": "# ARC Sequence Stamping

Solve ARC grids where the bottom row contains one or more color sequences and isolated cells elsewhere match values in those sequences.

1. Read each contiguous nonzero run in the bottom row as a separate source sequence, preserving its left-to-right order; finish when every run is recorded.
2. For each isolated nonzero cell above the source row, find the source run containing its color; leave the cell unchanged if no run contains it.
3. Copy that entire run horizontally onto the isolated cell's row, aligning the matching source value with the cell's original column; finish when the marker retains its coordinate and the sequence extends on both sides as available.
4. Clip copied cells at the grid boundaries, preserve all source runs and other cells, and verify dimensions and marker alignment before submitting.

Demonstrated examples support multiple source runs and edge clipping. A complete non-bottom row may itself be another source sequence when its colors recur as isolated markers; treat that as a source only when the puzzle layout indicates it, rather than assuming the bottom row is always the sole source."
}
